description: This source file implements a concurrency utility for testing purposes in Swift, including an actor for lock management and an enum providing functions to isolate and restore environment variables and user defaults within a test context.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor managing a lock to ensure exclusive access during test isolation procedures.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, suspending if already locked.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the lock and resumes any waiting coroutines.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a closure with environment variables and user defaults temporarily set to specified values, restoring previous state afterward.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Executes a closure with specified environment variables set, restoring previous state afterward.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Executes a closure with specified user defaults set, restoring previous state afterward.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a temporary file path for test configuration files.
